name: all-options
title: Every live option for Deidre
intro: Live switches: the Capability Statement card's drawing (?ridge=, 2026-11-13).

groups.heading: Capability Statement card: the drawing between the line and the codes
groups.intro: From 600px wide; phones have no room for it. Captured drawn and still (reduced motion).

options.label: Both
options.note: The layered ranges drawn back to front, then the alpenglow sweep along the near ridge (and faintly the middle one), leaving a warm edge on the summit.

options.label: Alpenglow
options.note: The one-line range drawn by the rust point, then a band of warm light sweeps along the ridge once and leaves a warm edge on the summit.

options.label: Layers
options.note: Three ranges in depth, drawn back to front; each hides the ones behind it and shifts with the card's turn.
